verdict.rationale: The only evidence that Azure ships first-party serverless functions is a community mention of Azure Functions [azure-comm-9]. That user also complains that logs and artifacts are hard to get at, which is an observability complaint and does not contradict the capability. Nothing in the pack documents triggers, limits, cold-start behavior, or serverless containers. Missing for 10: first-party Functions/serverless-container docs, documented trigger types, documented execution and scale limits, documented cold-start behavior, hands-on corroboration.
